docs.help:
Start a Game

Choose Play vs AI, pass-and-play, or online play. Pass-and-play lets both sides move on the same device according to the current turn.

Basics

  1. Click or drag a piece to move.
  2. Selection highlights, legal targets, and capture hints can be configured in Settings.
  3. Pause stops the clocks; resume restarts the current side's clock.

Replays

Use the File menu to save, export, or load .xhgame files. The replay window supports jumping, stepping, autoplay, and the local replay library.

Rule Notes

  • The Archer uses the weaker star-track move by default; the enhanced option expands it.
  • Every diagonal segment must pass the pincer check, including Advisor and Minister moves.
  • Soldiers can march quickly before entering enemy territory, stopping at the boundary.

Shortcuts

Ctrl+N New, Ctrl+O Load, Ctrl+S Export, Ctrl+Z Undo, Ctrl+R Replay, F11 Fullscreen.

Feedback

GitHub Issues · 2741526119@qq.com
docs.rules:
Detailed piece rules, enhanced options, and pincer checks can be reviewed and adjusted in Settings → Rules and appearance.

Every diagonal entry segment must pass the pincer check; quick soldier marches can move at most to the enemy-territory boundary.
docs.about:
Version 1.1.0

Xionghan Chess is a Chinese chess variant on a 13 × 13 expanded board, blending Xiongnu and Eastern Han themes with configurable special pieces and rules.

This Version

  • Supports Windows, Web, and Android.
  • Shares the Python rules, AI, online protocol, and .xhgame replay format.
  • Supports AI, pass-and-play, online rooms, pauseable clocks, replays, chat, and replay management.

Development

Developer: Jin Zhongyuan
Project: github.com/Jinny168/xionghan-chess
Email: 2741526119@qq.com

Thanks to the original project work, assets, menu design, player feedback, and the open-source tools and audio resources used here.
